description: Walk the VOLO Ontology directly. No arguments: the object types and link types. `type`: the objects of that type. `type` + `id`: one object's properties and everything it links to, grouped by link. Add `link` (and `direction`: out|in) to follow one link. Types include Occupation, Task, TaskJudgement, Evidence, Regulation, WorkActivity and ClassificationConcept. Read-only; judgements keep their basis and limits, evidence its scope — carry them into the answer. No aggregate score exists.
name: query_ontology
